svg.title: Impact, by the numbers
svg.desc: 600+ REST endpoints shipped to production (GoParkEasy · parking SaaS); 57 MongoDB collections, 6 user roles (GoParkEasy · data model); <100ms voice-agent replies on top intents (AI Receptionist · Retell AI); +35% ATS match score uplift, results in <5s (FixMyResume · Gemini + NLP); 85% classification accuracy on live traffic (BikeWatch · YOLOv5 + DeepSORT); 12 business verticals on one voice agent (AI Receptionist · SaaS)
